text:
max: quick heads-up — i'm adding kernel-selection telemetry fields to the runtime logs. want to converge on names and a debug flag flow before i push a PR.

jia: nice. can you list what you're planning to emit? short bullets are fine.

max: yeah — rough plan:
- kernel_choice: which kernel impl was selected (string)
- select_reason: short enum (latency_estimate | memory_estimate | arch_hint | override | fallback)
- arch: hw family (a100 | h100 | t4 | cpu)
- seq_len and seq_bucket: exact seq and bucket (<=64, <=256, <=1024, >1024)
- perf_est_ms: selection-time latency estimate (float)
- mem_est_bytes: estimated working set after kv + activations (int)
- kv_cached: boolean if prefix/KV cache hit influenced decision
- rollout_tag: e.g. "autotune-v2" or "legacy"
- sampling_level: quick|full (we'll sample only ~1% full perf counters)

oliver: please add a compact reason code for telemetry tags. we need to aggregate counts by reason. maybe select_reason_tag like rc_lat, rc_mem, rc_arch, rc_override, rc_fallback.

max: good call. i'll emit both human-friendly select_reason and a short tag select_reason_tag.

emma: how will debug flags work? we shouldn't blow up logs in prod.

max: plan: env flags and config: 
- REDWOOD_KERNEL_TELEMETRY=1 to enable minimal telemetry (counts + tag distribution)
- REDWOOD_KERNEL_TELEMETRY_FULL=1 to enable full JSON lines with perf_est_ms/mem_est and kv details (rate-limited)
- REDWOOD_KERNEL_DEBUG=1 to emit debug-level selection trace for sampled requests (stack of heuristics and scores)
- RW_KERN_SELECT_OVERRIDE=flash_attn_v2 to force kernel for local debug

infra-bot: note: production logging budget suggest full lines only at 0.5% sample and backpressure to structured logging pipeline.

max: agree. default will be REDWOOD_KERNEL_TELEMETRY=1 globally, FULL=off, DEBUG=off. Ops can flip per-cluster.

jia: example log line please — single-line JSON we can grep/parse.

max: good idea, here's the draft single-line: 
```
{"ts":"2026-03-16T14:12:03Z","req_id":"r_7f3b","model":"redwood-7b","arch":"h100","seq_len":128,"seq_bucket":"<=256","chosen_kernel":"flash_attn_v2","select_reason":"latency_estimate","select_reason_tag":"rc_lat","perf_est_ms":11.8,"mem_est_bytes":54272000,"kv_cached":true,"rollout_tag":"autotune-v2","sampling_level":"quick"}
```

oliver: looks good. add kernel_version or commit hash? helps debug regressions.

max: will add kernel_rev (short commit sha) and runtime_build. updated example: 
```
{"ts":"2026-03-16T14:12:03Z","req_id":"r_7f3b","model":"redwood-7b","arch":"h100","seq_len":128,"seq_bucket":"<=256","chosen_kernel":"flash_attn_v2","kernel_rev":"a3f9c7b","runtime_build":"2026-03-10-rc3","select_reason":"latency_estimate","select_reason_tag":"rc_lat","perf_est_ms":11.8,"mem_est_bytes":54272000,"kv_cached":true,"rollout_tag":"autotune-v2","sampling_level":"quick"}
```

emma: for KV behavior, can we include kv_delta_bytes (how much extra memory reading KV added) and kv_hit_ratio for the request if available? helps in cases where cache influences kernel pick.

max: yes — will add kv_delta_bytes (int) and kv_hit (true/false). kv_hit_ratio only for full samples.

ops-bot: alert rule suggestion: if median perf_est_ms for a kernel on a single model+seq_bucket increases >20% over baseline for 1h, page eng-runtime. Also surface kernel_fallback.count spikes.

max: we should also emit a tiny metric stream to prometheus: kernel_choice.count{kernel,arch,seq_bucket,reason_tag}, kernel_select_latency_ms{kernel,model}. the logs are for postmortem and detailed debugging.

jia: what about sequence-length-dependent code paths? want a reason code that indicates branch chosen like "short_seq_opt" or "long_seq_kv_mode".

max: good point — will extend select_reason_tag with sub-tags: e.g. rc_lat_shortseq, rc_lat_longseq_kv. also add path_tag: flash_shortseq | flash_longseq_kv | fallback_gemm. path_tag will be a free-form but limited set.

oliver: how do we ensure telemetry doesn't leak PII? check model names are safe — but request-level tokens must never be logged. make sure req_id is a random opaque id.

max: agreed. req_id is opaque. no prompt or tokens will be emitted. full-sample will include a tiny perf counter dump only (no text).

emma: performance regression hunt: can we log selection_time_ms (time to compute which kernel) separate from perf_est_ms (predicted runtime)? that helps if selector itself is slow after we add heuristics.

max: will add selector_latency_ms. good catch.

infra-bot: implementation notes: append these fields in the kernel selector code path before we mutate runtime state. push as single structured log line to stdout/stderr and to the structured logging pipeline via our shim. sampling will be controlled by a lightweight fast-rand check at request admission.

max: PR plan:
1) add telemetry struct + tests (unit)
2) wire env flags and sampling gating
3) emit prometheus counters + histogram
4) end-to-end test on staging with REDWOOD_KERNEL_TELEMETRY_FULL=1 at 1%
5) roll to prod default minimal telemetry, full off

jia: one more ask — add an internal debug endpoint /_debug/last_kernel_choice that returns last N choices for a worker (only enabled in dev/staging). helps repro flaky picks.

max: i'll add that behind DEV_ONLY flag.

ops-bot: reminder to add retention policy: full selection logs stored 7d; summary metrics forever.

oliver: can you include a sample debug trace (what REDWOOD_KERNEL_DEBUG=1 emits) — just a short snippet so infra knows format.

max: here's a sample debug trace (multi-line, human readable) we emit to the debug logger when flag on for that request:
```
[DEBUG] req=r_7f3b model=redwood-7b arch=h100 seq=128
 heuristics: {flash_attn_v2:lat_est=11.8,mem_ok=true,quant_friendly=true,score=0.87}
 heuristics: {flash_attn_v1:lat_est=13.5,mem_ok=true,score=0.76}
 heuristics: {fallback_gemm:lat_est=22.3,mem_ok=false,score=0.31}
 chosen=flash_attn_v2 reason=latency_estimate confidence=0.11 selector_latency_ms=0.42
```

emma: excellent. that will help perf regressions.

max: thanks all — i'll open the PR with the schema and ping this thread. if anyone has objections to field names call out now. otherwise i'll land an RFC doc in docs/ once PR merges. :thumbsup:

jia: LGTM

emma: LGTM

infra-bot: deploy-bot: created rollout-plan #deploys/kerntel. sampling set to 1% for staging.

ops-bot: noted.

max: merging in a few hours if no comments.
